name: KCN Command Center
postCreateCommand: unzip -o KCN-Command-Center.zip -d /tmp/kcn && cp -rn /tmp/kcn/KCN/Worldview/* Worldview/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp -rn /tmp/kcn/KCN/Cyber-Security-HQ/* Cyber-Security-HQ/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp -rn /tmp/kcn/KCN/Nano-Banana-World-Design/* Nano-Banana-World-Design/ 2>/dev/null || true; cp -rn /tmp/kcn/KCN/Human-AI-Personal-Growth/* Human-AI-Personal-Growth/ 2>/dev/null || true; echo '✅ KCN prototypes extracted. Static server starting on port 8080. Open the forwarded port.'
